title: 第9章 瀚海蛟龙武魂一剑风云动第10章 燃烧武魂瀚海之矛
content_zh:
第9章瀚海蛟龙武魂，一剑风云动！
大长老死死盯着林尘，眼神仿佛能杀人！
他没有看到真武杀阵里面的具体情况，但，楚琉光跟林尘有过冲突，唯一有可能动手的就是林尘。
“大胆林尘！
你敢残害同门，该当何罪！”
大长老怒极，体内一股狂暴的灵力冲出！
“你哪只眼睛看到是我杀了楚琉光？”
林尘眼神冷厉，丝毫不让，释放出一股惊人的气息。
林尘的境界，突破到了灵纹二重。
在真武杀阵当中，林尘体内的灵力不断凝练，顺势突破境界。
大长老脸色一变。
没有想到，林尘已经恢复到了灵纹境，还能借杀阵突破！
不远处，武极宗宗主同样脸色大变。
如此年轻的灵纹境，在青州城当中，绝对称得上天骄。
“可惜，他武魂被废，就算现在能把境界提上去，以后也走不远。”
“若他武魂还在，未来的青州必然是他的天下，乃至整个大禹皇朝年轻一辈都有他的一席之地，实在可惜。”
宗主摇头，心中感慨。
柳嫣然看到林尘展露锋芒，绝美的脸上浮现一抹笑意，如一朵娇艳欲滴的玫瑰。
在武魂被废的情况下，林尘还能短时间内提升境界，其天赋和毅力，称得上妖孽。
柳嫣然替林尘感到高兴，虽武魂被废，但武道之路，除了天赋之外，更重要的是毅力，以及一颗坚定的道心。

“残杀同门，还敢对本座不敬，今日本座将你就地正法！”
大长老怒极，眼中杀意强烈，林尘的天赋，让他隐隐有一丝忌惮。
此子，哪怕没有武魂，也不能留！
“大长老，你根本拿不出证据，却非要污蔑林公子，就算你位高权重，也不该如此不公！”
柳嫣然站了出来，挡在林尘的面前。
大长老实力极强，乃是灵海境强者，觉醒的武魂品质也很高，柳嫣然担心林尘的安全。
林尘心中一暖，柳嫣然一直对他很不错。
“大长老，此事以后再仔细调查就是。”
宗主发话了。
大长老脸色阴沉。
宗主言下之意很清楚，凡事都讲证据，既然没有证据，便不可追究。
content_en:
Chapter 9: Vast Sea Dragon Martial Spirit, a sword that moves the wind and clouds!
The Great Elder stared at Lin Chen with eyes that could kill people!
He did not see the specific situation inside the Zhenwu Killing Formation, but Chu Liuguang had a conflict with Lin Chen, and the only one who might take action was Lin Chen.
"Bold Lin Chen!
You dare to harm your fellow disciples, what crime should you be punished for? "
The great elder was extremely angry, and a violent spiritual power rushed out of his body!
"Which of your eyes saw that I killed Chu Liuguang?"
Lin Chen's eyes were cold and stern, and he did not give in at all, releasing an astonishing aura.
Lin Chen's realm broke through to the second level of spiritual patterns.
In the Zhenwu Killing Formation, the spiritual power in Lin Chen's body continued to condense, and he broke through the realm.
The great elder's expression changed.
Unexpectedly, Lin Chen had already recovered to the spirit pattern realm and could use the killing array to break through!
Not far away, the face of the leader of Wuji Sect also changed drastically.
Such a young person in the spirit pattern realm is definitely considered a genius in Qingzhou City.
"It's a pity that his martial spirit has been abolished. Even if he can improve his realm now, he won't be able to go far in the future."
"If his martial spirit is still there, Qingzhou will definitely be his world in the future, and even the younger generation of the entire Yu Dynasty will have his place. It is a pity."
The sect leader shook his head and sighed in his heart.
Liu Yanran saw Lin Chen showing off his talents, and a smile appeared on his beautiful face, like a delicate rose.
Even when his martial spirit was abolished, Lin Chen could still improve his level in a short period of time. His talent and perseverance were worthy of being called a monster.
Liu Yanran was happy for Lin Chen. Although the martial arts soul was abolished, in addition to talent, the path to martial arts is more important than perseverance and a firm Taoist heart.
"You slaughtered your fellow disciples and dared to be disrespectful to me. Today I will execute you on the spot!"
The great elder was extremely angry, with strong murderous intent in his eyes. Lin Chen's talent made him faintly afraid.
This son, even if he has no martial spirit, cannot be kept!
"Great Elder, you can't produce any evidence, but you still insist on slandering Mr. Lin. Even if you have a high position, you shouldn't be so unfair!"
Liu Yanran stood up and stood in front of Lin Chen.
The Great Elder was extremely powerful, a strong man in the Spiritual Sea Realm, and the quality of his awakened martial soul was also very high. Liu Yanran was worried about Lin Chen's safety.
Lin Chen felt warm in his heart, Liu Yanran had always been very kind to him.
"Great Elder, we will investigate this matter carefully later."
The sect master has spoken.
The great elder's face was gloomy.
The implication of the sect leader's words is very clear. Everything depends on evidence. Since there is no evidence, there can be no investigation.
